mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_lookups (user_id, course_id, basis_key, query_key, query_json, clue_origin, clue_material_id, clue_file_hash, clue_extractor_version, textbook_version, force_refresh, status, max_attempts, next_run_at, result_json, reused_from_lookup_id, auto_tidy_state, error_code, error_message, finished_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{basisKey}, #{queryKey}, #{queryJson}, #{clueOrigin}, #{clueMaterialId}, #{clueFileHash}, #{clueExtractorVersion}, #{textbookVersion}, #{forceRefresh}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{maxAttempts}, 3), COALESCE(#{nextRunAt}, NOW()), #{resultJson}, #{reusedFromLookupId}, COALESCE(#{autoTidyState}, 'NONE'), #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lookup_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lookup_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND query_key = #{queryKey} AND ((status IN ('FOUND', 'NEEDS_CHOICE', 'BOOK_NO_TOC') AND finished_at >= #{longSince}) OR (status = 'NOT_FOUND' AND finished_at >= #{shortSince})) ORDER BY lookup_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_lookups SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', finished_at = NOW(), lease_token = lease_token + 1, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'SUPERSEDED', error_message = #{reason} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE textbook_lookups SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, NOW()), lease_token = lease_token + 1, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE (status = 'QUEUED' AND next_run_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, lookup_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_lookups SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_token = lease_token + 1, attempt = attempt + 1 WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND ((status = 'QUEUED' AND next_run_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}))
UPDATE textbook_lookups SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT lookup_id FROM textbook_lookups WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_lookups SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, query_json = COALESCE(#{queryJson}, query_json), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, auto_tidy_state = COALESCE(#{autoTidyState}, auto_tidy_state), finished_at = NOW(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE textbook_lookups SET status = 'QUEUED', next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE textbook_lookups SET basis_key = #{basisKey}, query_key = #{queryKey}, query_json = #{queryJson}, clue_material_id = #{clueMaterialId}, clue_file_hash = #{clueFileHash}, clue_extractor_version = #{clueExtractorVersion}, textbook_version = #{textbookVersion} WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE textbook_lookups SET query_json = #{queryJson} WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE textbook_lookups SET chosen_revision_id = #{revisionId} WHERE lookup_id = #{lookupId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM textbook_lookups WHERE auto_tidy_state IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING_OPEN_PROPOSAL') AND status IN ('FOUND', 'NEEDS_CHOICE') AND (auto_tidy_next_at IS NULL OR auto_tidy_next_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(auto_tidy_next_at, created_at) ASC, lookup_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_lookups l JOIN (SELECT course_id, user_id, MAX(lookup_id) AS mx FROM textbook_lookups GROUP BY course_id, user_id) m ON m.mx = l.lookup_id SET l.auto_tidy_state = 'PENDING', l.auto_tidy_next_at = NULL WHERE l.status IN ('FOUND', 'NEEDS_CHOICE') AND l.auto_tidy_state IN ('DONE', 'ENQUEUED')
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO textbook_lookup_usage (user_id, usage_date, calls) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_lookup_usage SET calls = calls + #{n} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND usage_date = #{date} AND calls + #{n} <= #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT calls FROM textbook_lookup_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND usage_date = #{date}
